restoredFrom.description: The version whose content was restored.

toVersion.description: The NEW version the rollback created. History is immutable: restoring deletes nothing, it adds.

cacheInvalidated.description: Whether the engine's instruction cache was successfully invalidated.

400.description: Version is not a positive integer.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, event, or version does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
